findings.evidence: Basic.lean:978-983 `decomposition_unique ... (hU : UniquenessAssumptions g K)`; Decomposition.lean:279-288 shows `hSymm`/`hQ2`/`hTT`/`he` occurring only inside the `uniquenessAssumptionsOfSpectator` application, and `fromF1F2_add_smul_apply_of_spectator` (line 188) takes only `heq heT hee'`.
findings.fix: State it as `theorem fromF1F2_add_smul_injective {A : Bilin V} (hU : UniquenessAssumptions g K) {e e' : V} (heq : g K.q e = 0) (heT : g (pTransverse g K) e = 0) (hee' : g e e' = 0) (hA : A e e' ≠ 0) : Function.Injective fun F : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => fromF1F2 g K F.1 F.2.1 + F.2.2 • A`, passing `hU` to `decomposition_unique`; `existsUnique_eq_fromF1F2_add_smul` then supplies `uniquenessAssumptionsOfSpectator hSymm hQ2 hTT hP.q_orthogonal_e₁ hP.pT_orthogonal_e₁ hP.e₁_self_ne_zero` itself.
findings.issue: `fromF1F2_add_smul_injective` takes `hSymm`, `hQ2`, `hTT` and `he`, which are used only to build `uniquenessAssumptionsOfSpectator hSymm hQ2 hTT heq heT he` (line 288); the parity-odd step uses only `heq`, `heT`, `hee'`, `hA`. The general `decomposition_unique` is stated for an arbitrary `UniquenessAssumptions g K`, so this uniqueness statement is needlessly tied to spectator-built probe pairs.

findings.evidence: grep for `fromF1F2_add_smul_flip` over `EpsilonEridani/` returns only its own declaration at Decomposition.lean:196; lines 206 and 213 apply the `Bilin.` lemmas directly.
findings.fix: Drop it, or use it in the proofs of the two `inv_two_smul_fromF1F2_add_smul_*` theorems so it carries weight.
findings.issue: `fromF1F2_add_smul_flip` has no use in the repository: the two `inv_two_smul_fromF1F2_add_smul_*` theorems below it go straight to `Bilin.inv_two_smul_{add,sub}_flip_of_isSymm_of_isAlt`, and it is not cited in the module docstring's main results. It is a bare specialization of `Bilin.flip_add_smul_of_isSymm_of_isAlt` at `fromF1F2_isSymm`.

summary: The decomposition sits at the right level overall, but the uniqueness theorem hard-wires one construction of the F1/F2 probe pairs and so carries three hypotheses the underlying `decomposition_unique` does not need; one new flip specialization has no use anywhere.
